title: Distinguish Frontend vs Backend Responsibilities
description: Categorize software architecture responsibilities into client-side browser execution vs server-side data persistence and API processing.

title: Classify Full-Stack Responsibilities
description: Distinguish between client-side responsibilities (rendering, interaction, client state) and server-side responsibilities (database queries, authentication, business APIs).

title: Differentiate HTML, CSS, and JS Roles
description: Map specific web features and file responsibilities to the correct language: HTML for document structure, CSS for presentation, and JavaScript for runtime interaction.

title: Explain Client-Side Browser Execution
description: Trace how the browser receives assets over HTTP, builds the DOM and CSSOM, and runs the JavaScript event loop to power interactive web applications.

title: Author Syntactically Valid HTML
description: Construct well-formed HTML document fragments with matching tags, proper attribute quotes, and correct semantic elements.

title: Parse HTML Element Syntax
description: Identify and dissect opening tags, closing tags, attribute names, attribute values, and child content in HTML code.

title: Construct HTML Attributes
description: Configure elements using valid attribute name-value pairs, boolean attributes, class names, IDs, and resource URLs.

title: Nest HTML Elements Structurally
description: Construct valid hierarchical DOM structures by nesting child elements cleanly inside parent container elements without overlapping boundaries.

title: Implement CSS Flexbox Layouts
description: Apply display: flex, flex-direction, justify-content, and align-items to build flexible 1-dimensional layouts.

title: Identify Main and Cross Axes
description: Determine the orientation of the main axis and cross axis based on the flex-direction property (row vs column).

title: Predict Flex Item Alignment & Distribution
description: Predict visual placement of flex items under combinations of justify-content (center, space-between, flex-start) and align-items.

title: Author CSS Flexbox Rules
description: Write clean, robust CSS rules using display: flex, justify-content, align-items, and gap to build real-world UI components.

title: Author and Invoke JavaScript Functions
description: Write parameterized functions, execute them with arguments, and return computed results to calling contexts.

title: Distinguish Return Values from Console Logging
description: Differentiate between producing a return value for caller expressions and emitting debug strings to the console via console.log.

title: Predict Call Expression Values
description: Trace function execution to predict what a function call evaluates to in variable assignments and arithmetic expressions.

title: Author Functions with Return Values
description: Write reusable JavaScript functions that calculate data, explicitly return results, and compose cleanly with callers.

title: Diagnose Multi-File Frontend Defects
description: Isolate HTML structure errors, CSS styling failures, and JavaScript runtime errors in a multi-file web project.

title: Diagnose Symptom Root Causes
description: Formulate hypotheses explaining broken visual or interactive behaviors by inspecting symptoms across HTML, CSS, and JS layers.

title: Formulate Debugging Hypotheses
description: Use console logs, error stack traces, and element inspection to locate exact lines containing syntax, selector, or null reference bugs.

title: Repair Multi-File Frontend Defects
description: Apply surgical code corrections to HTML markup, CSS stylesheet rules, and JavaScript DOM handlers to restore application functionality.

title: Explain Browser JavaScript Execution
description: Trace how JavaScript runs inside the browser environment, responds to user actions, and interacts with the DOM tree.

title: Trace DOM Event Flow & UI Updates
description: Connect user interactions to DOM event listeners and state changes that trigger real-time interface rendering.

title: Declare Variables with let and const
description: Choose between const for fixed references and let for mutable state, avoiding global variable pollution.

title: Reassign and Track Variable State
description: Track variable values over time, avoiding illegal const reassignments and accidental type changes.

title: Evaluate Comparisons with Strict Equality
description: Use strict equality (===) and inequality (!==) operators to compare values safely without type coercion surprises.

title: Predict and Control Type Coercion
description: Identify implicit conversions between strings, numbers, and booleans, and use explicit conversion functions.

title: Author Conditional Logic Branches
description: Implement if, else if, and else blocks using logical operators to make decisions based on runtime state.

title: Evaluate Truthy and Falsy Expressions
description: Predict whether values evaluate to true or false in boolean context, handling 0, empty strings, null, and undefined correctly.

title: Author Iterative For Loops
description: Construct for and while loops with accurate initialization, boundary conditions, and step expressions.

title: Apply the Accumulator Pattern
description: Use loop accumulation to calculate totals, build formatted strings, and aggregate data elements.

title: Manipulate Array Collections
description: Create, index, push, pop, and slice array items using zero-based index operations and length properties.

title: Transform Arrays with Iteration Methods
description: Process arrays using loops and transformation methods to filter and map data without mutating original sources.

title: Author and Structure JavaScript Objects
description: Model real-world entities using object literal notation with key-value pairs, strings, numbers, and booleans.

title: Access and Mutate Nested Object Properties
description: Navigate complex data trees using dot and bracket notation, updating properties and handling nested structures.

title: Synthesize Composite JavaScript Programs
description: Combine variables, branching, loops, functions, arrays, and objects to build interactive web application logic.
